title: CppCon 2016: Chandler Carruth “Garbage In, Garbage Out: Arguing about Undefined Behavior..."
summary: Chandler Carruth's CppCon 2016 talk tries to defuse the heated debate over undefined behavior in C and C++. He explains from the compiler writer's perspective why UB exists and how it enables optimization.
why: HN points to it whenever undefined behavior comes up, as the best explanation of the reasoning behind UB, though some dispute its framing.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: Chandler Carruth's talk on the subject was really useful for my own understanding of the reasoning behind UB
